metadata.focus: IOC current country names and codes, with ISO alpha-3 crosswalks and North American subdivision flag aliases
notes: countryToIoc always returns the current IOC code for known country names and aliases.
isoToIoc converts current ISO alpha-3 codes to the current IOC code for the same country where an IOC code exists.
flagAliasToCode resolves display-team inputs to the actual short flag filename code.
Some 3-letter codes are ambiguous across systems; see ambiguousCodes.
Some human-readable names are ambiguous across countries and subdivisions; see ambiguousFlagAliases.

BRN.note: Current IOC code BRN means Bahrain, while current ISO alpha-3 code BRN means Brunei.

aliases: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
